svg.aria-label: Deployment view of the webshop: one subscription-scope deployment creates a platform resource group with monitoring, identities, Key Vault and the network, a data resource group with SQL, storage, Cosmos DB, Redis, Service Bus and Event Grid, and an apps resource group with App Service, Functions, Container Apps, API Management, Front Door and the optional AI services; module outputs flow from platform to data to apps, and DNS records land in an existing shared zone.
svg.title: Webshop deployment view
svg.text: webshop.bicep, targetScope = subscription · one deployment per environment (dev, test, prod)
identities, Key Vault, subnets, App Insights connection string
